derived_candidates.text: The inventor of the first laser printer available to the mass market may be associated with the Alan and Priscilla Oppenheimer Foundation.
The Tektronix Phaser 740 is described as the industry's first true 1200×1200 dpi color laser printer, but not necessarily the first mass-market laser printer.
The NeXT Laser Printer was an early laser printer sold from 1988 to 1993, but its market reach may not qualify as mass market.
